da-false-claim.evidence: The application section claims ${}^{56}\mathrm{Fe}$ and ${}^{208}\mathrm{Pb}$ 'sit in this regime' of Z = N even-even. This is a false claim in basic nuclear physics: ${}^{56}\mathrm{Fe}$ has Z=26, N=30, and ${}^{208}\mathrm{Pb}$ has Z=82, N=126. They are not Z=N.
